name: Healing Techniques (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja has turned her study of vital areas and pressure points to potentially beneficial use. The ninja gains Heal as a class skill. The ninja may spend one ki point to gain a +4 insight bonus to a single Heal check.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
